LanguageData.ASE_Overdrive_T1.label: overdrive T1
LanguageData.ASE_Overdrive_T1.description: The android receives a slight optimization in motor circuits. Runs faster, but the battery drains quickly.
LanguageData.ASE_Overdrive_T2.label: overdrive T2
LanguageData.ASE_Overdrive_T2.description: Overclocking of stepper motor protocols. The android moves even faster, but is unable to carry heavy items.
LanguageData.ASE_Overdrive_T3.label: overdrive T3
LanguageData.ASE_Overdrive_T3.description: The android moves at the limit of its capabilities, but its carrying capacity in this configuration is minimal.
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocol_T1.label: productivity protocol T1
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocol_T1.description: Work speed is slightly increased at the cost of higher energy consumption.
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocol_T2.label: productivity protocol T2
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocol_T2.description: Work speed is significantly increased at the cost of even higher energy consumption.
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocol_T3.label: productivity protocol T3
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocol_T3.description: Incredible productivity boost, but the cost is the inability to work efficiently at high temperatures.
LanguageData.ASE_ProductivityProtocol_T3.customEffect: The lower the temperature, the higher the work speed. Each degree below 20°C grants +2% global work speed, each degree above 20°C grants -2% global work speed.
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolder_T1.label: cargo holder upgrade T1
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolder_T2.label: cargo holder upgrade T2
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolder_T2.description: Doubled-capacity cargo compartment, but the android's movement speed is slightly reduced.
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolder_T3.label: cargo holder upgrade T3
LanguageData.ASE_CargoHolder_T3.description: Maximum carrying capacity, but significant speed reduction.
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCore_T1.label: research core T1
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCore_T1.description: Improved search and data systematization algorithms increase research speed.
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCore_T2.label: research core T2
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCore_T2.description: Expanded memory blocks for even greater research acceleration.
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCore_T3.label: research core T3
LanguageData.ASE_ResearchCore_T3.description: Computational blocks operate at the limit, generating enormous amounts of heat and requiring additional cooling.
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutine_T1.label: mining subroutine T1
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutine_T1.description: Rock structure analysis increases mining efficiency.
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutine_T2.label: mining subroutine T2
LanguageData.ASE_MiningSubroutine_T2.description: Improved sensors provide even more resources.
LanguageData.ASE_DeepMiningSensors.label: deep mining sensors
LanguageData.ASE_DeepMiningSensors.description: Specialized sensors for deep mining of rare resources.
LanguageData.ASE_DrillingSpecialist.label: drilling specialist
LanguageData.ASE_DrillingSpecialist.description: Doubled drilling speed thanks to abandoning standard speech protocols.
LanguageData.ASE_DrillingSpecialist.customEffectDescr: Hearing loss and inability to communicate
LanguageData.ASE_FieldMedic.label: field medic
LanguageData.ASE_FieldMedic.description: Emergency protocols for accelerated treatment of wounded fighters directly on the battlefield. Fast, but not very high quality.
LanguageData.ASE_SurgicalUnit.label: surgical unit
LanguageData.ASE_SurgicalUnit.description: Special model designed for use in elite clinics. Equipment fragility prevents the android from being used for heavy work.
LanguageData.ASE_AgroDrone.label: agro-drone
LanguageData.ASE_AgroDrone.description: Optimized for harvesting crops and cutting down trees.
LanguageData.ASE_NarcoticHarvester.label: narcotic harvester
LanguageData.ASE_NarcoticHarvester.description: Thanks to improved motor skills, ideal for growing illegal crops, but has much lower durability compared to standard models.
LanguageData.ASE_ShredderCore.label: shredder core
LanguageData.ASE_ShredderCore.description: Specialized mechanoid processing unit that occasionally finds additional components in them.
LanguageData.ASE_ButcherCore.label: butcher core
LanguageData.ASE_ButcherCore.description: This protocol ignores sanitary standards and butchers carcasses at double speed.
LanguageData.ASE_ButcherCore.customEffectDescriptions: +10000% food poisoning chance when cooking food
LanguageData.ASE_SmelterCore.label: smelter core
LanguageData.ASE_SmelterCore.description: Special protocol for metal smelting, allows faster smelting and occasionally obtaining rare components.
LanguageData.ASE_DiplomaticCore.label: diplomatic core
LanguageData.ASE_DiplomaticCore.description: Android diplomat for trade and negotiations. To build trust with trading partners, it technically cannot use ranged weapons.
LanguageData.ASE_SuppressionUnit.label: suppression unit
LanguageData.ASE_SuppressionUnit.description: Specialization for capturing prisoners and suppressing riots, but built-in blades slightly reduce movement speed.
LanguageData.ASE_PropagandaBroadcaster.label: propaganda broadcaster
LanguageData.ASE_PropagandaBroadcaster.description: Thanks to its huge built-in speakers, can influence the opinions of others, but the equipment slightly reduces movement speed.
LanguageData.ASE_ThermalRegulator_T1.label: thermal regulator T1
LanguageData.ASE_ThermalRegulator_T2.label: thermal regulator T2
LanguageData.ASE_ConstructionMatrix.label: construction matrix
LanguageData.ASE_ConstructionMatrix.description: The android is designed for heavy work on construction sites in new, unexplored worlds.
LanguageData.ASE_DecentralizedMind.label: decentralized mind
LanguageData.ASE_DecentralizedMind.description: Distributed computing allows even load distribution across all android CPUs present on the map, increasing their efficiency.
LanguageData.ASE_DecentralizedMind.customEffectDescri: +10% global work speed per android with this gene on the map
LanguageData.ASE_ResourceScanner.label: resource scanner
LanguageData.ASE_ResourceScanner.description: Built-in metal detector that sometimes marks previously unknown deposits of valuable materials.
LanguageData.ASE_ResourceScanner.customEffectDescript: Once per day reveals a random underground deposit
